title: Zig It Right

moves: Larks draw neighbor robin to your side
In long lines, go forward and back
Weave the line with neighbor (R;L to S1)

notes: Inspired by 'Zag it Back' by Jacqui Grennan.
I love the combinations of circling right after curtesy turns.
The B1 is a bit quick, as alternative is to skip the balance at the top of B2 to give more time to get around on the allemande.
